pages.title: It Was Very Good
pages.child_instruction: Color the hillside, creek, trees, and animals God made.
pages.bible_connection: This scene is a picture of looking at what God made and saying it is very good.
pages.visual_prompt: Integrated black line-art coloring scene: autumn hillside, creek, oak trees, a deer at the water, birds, a child sitting on a rock looking out. No letters in the artwork. Do not copy Mission 2's sun-moon-stars orchard.

pages.title: Find What God Made
pages.child_instruction: Find and circle all 8 wonders God made. Each one can remind you that creation is very good.
pages.bible_connection: Looking closely at what God made is practice for seeing that it was very good.
pages.visual_prompt: Controlled hillside-and-creek background without the eight targets. Independently placed oak leaf, pinecone, deer, creek fish, mushroom, bird nest, pebble, and ladybug.

pages.title: Follow the Creek to the Lookout
pages.child_instruction: Start at the creek stone. Follow the path to the lookout hill.
pages.bible_connection: Walking to the lookout is a picture of stopping to see that what God made is very good.
pages.visual_prompt: One creek-and-hill scene: stepping stone at START, unique creek-bank maze, lookout hill with a wide view at FINISH. Not a maze pasted on a blank page.

pages.title: Care for What God Made
pages.child_instruction: Check how you can care for creation. Then draw one thing God made that is very good.
pages.bible_connection: Caring for what God made is a child-sized answer to Genesis 1:31: it was very good.
pages.visual_prompt: One hill-framed page: four illustrated choices, a large nature drawing area, and a short prayer ribbon.

choices.label: Thank God for making it good

pages.drawing_prompt: Draw one thing God made that is very good
pages.prayer: God, thank You for making a world that is very good.
